<description>
Significantly improves loadtxoutset performance via a number of changes:

 * parallel threads for decoding, hashing, serializing and writing to leveldb
 * no fsync() gating writes
 * no redundant loading into CoinsView

Also adds a subcommand to bitcoin-util for getting a snapshot's hash_serialized_3, muhash, coin count and total amount values without importing to leveldb first.

On my systems, performance ends up bottlenecked by leveldb CPU usage.
</description>

[2026-10-22] c:6338585430 comment by ajtowns (member) (edited 2026-10-25):
The performance change I see on a Ryzen 9 3900X system with RAID HDD storage is ~11minutes with to ~1m35s for a load, consisting of ~1m15s of CPU time followed by ~20s of disk flushing; with SSD and a slightly faster CPU, total time is reduced from ~5m30s to ~50s (no significant flush delay after the CPU work is completed here). These numbers are with the block 965000 utxo set.
